import boto3
from moto import mock_ssm
with mock_ssm():
    client = boto3.client('ssm')
    for x in 'ab':
        client.put_parameter(Name=f'test_my_param_01_{x}', Value=f'Contents of param {x}', Type='String',
                             Tags=[{'Key': 'hello', 'Value': 'world'}, {'Key': 'x', 'Value': x}])
    r1 = client.describe_parameters(ParameterFilters=[{'Key': 'tag:x', 'Option': 'Equals', 'Values': ['b']}, {'Key': 'tag:hello', 'Option': 'Equals', 'Values': ['world']}])
    r2 = client.describe_parameters(ParameterFilters=[{'Key': 'tag:hello', 'Option': 'Equals', 'Values': ['world']}, {'Key': 'tag:x', 'Option': 'Equals', 'Values': ['b']}])
    print('hello_second', len(r1['Parameters']), 'hello_first', len(r2['Parameters']))
    assert len(r1['Parameters']) == 1 and len(r2['Parameters']) == 1
PY
